first_call.method: first call of the row in a fresh process after a CUDA warm-up op (seconds, host wall clock incl. the row's imports, module load / JIT compile and the first launch) and the steady per-call ms after it (median of 5); 'cold' = empty Triton cache dir (TRITON_CACHE_DIR=<new>), 'warm' = a second process on the same cache dir; exactln rows: 'cold'/'warm' serve the shipped CUBIN bundle (no compile), 'compile' = OPT_CORE_EXACTLN_PREBUILT=0 with an empty NVRTC disk cache (the path before the bundle); sizes: LN pair C=384 N=800 (640000 rows; exactln:triton at C=128), APB DiT S=5 N=800 16x48 bf16 (fp32 for fpf_apb:fp16 / dit_exact) and pairformer S=1 N=384 16x24
first_call.lnl_pinned_tiles: lnl_fused serves its per-arch tiles table WITHOUT a search (the autotuner's cache pinned per key; a key the row lacks = the row's principal tile; no row for the arch = the module's default tile); 'sweep' = PF_LNL_AUTOTUNE_ALL=1, the full-list autotune that writes the table; Autotuner._bench trapped: 0 calls in serving mode; out = bf16(LN(x) @ W^T) is never transposed, y16 (write_y) is [B,J,I,C] when transposed -- max-abs vs the bf16 statements 1.6e-2 (out) / 1.6e-2 (y16, one bf16 ulp) in every form incl. write_y / transpose, pinned and swept

in_model.note: engine-reported in-model deltas for a (cc, form) cell, kept beside the same-box kernel cells; a tier word flips only on a same-box win >= 5 % (parity keeps the incumbent); an in-model report that contradicts a tier word is recorded here and decides per the DEFAULT-FLIP rule

big_rule: big = the fast winner unless its recorded peak (peak_mib) exceeds the stock arm's by more than 2%% + 16 MiB; then the fastest fast-admissible arm, the stock arm included, whose peak does not exceed that bound; no peak record for either -> big == fast
excluded_rule: excluded_arms: arms a tier word (fast | big | faithful | exact) never resolves in that cell, by an engine's in-model measurement stated per arm; the row word still serves them by name
